infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: PulseTrack uses Bluetooth to reach nearby PulseTrack devices when mobile networks are down.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: PulseTrack advertises an emergency beacon to nearby devices.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PulseTrack uses your location to send rescue coordinates during an emergency.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PulseTrack uses your location to show your position and send it with an alert.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PulseTrack records a short voice clip during an emergency and measures ambient sound to detect a structural collapse.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PulseTrack captures photo or video evidence during an emergency for responders.
